args.content: Working definition: a 'premium order' is any order placed by a customer on the enterprise tier (customers.tier = 'enterprise'). To identify premium orders, join memory.bench.orders to memory.bench.customers on customer_id and filter customers.tier = 'enterprise'. This is distinct from the 'key account' concept (customers on plus OR enterprise tier, see Customer Tier Definitions knowledge page kp-bench-4) — premium order is enterprise-tier only.
